description: Search city names. Explicit match uses the spelling search route; numeric/map/timezone/sort filters apply to default prefix search only. Deep adds the profile inside each returned city on paid plans.

aliases.description: Match reviewed normalized aliases. Compatibility characters, case and whitespace normalize; native marks and accents remain. No spelling guesses. Requires foundation readiness.

bbox.description: Stored-center bounds as west,south,east,north in degrees. West greater than east crosses the date line.

countries.description: Include ISO2 countries, as CSV or an array. Intersects with a single country filter; on named nearby, country selects the anchor.

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Reuse with exactly the same query, filters, limit, display language, Deep, hierarchy and origin.

deep.description: Include the complete detail bag on a paid plan.

exclude_countries.description: Exclude ISO2 countries, as CSV or an array.

format.description: Opt into object:list, data and next_cursor. A null cursor ends the collection; keep the same options on continuation.

grain.description: Reviewed entity grain. Unreviewed places do not match; requires City foundation readiness.

hierarchy.description: Include reviewed grain and immediate parent summary, or null when unknown. Requires foundation readiness; otherwise 503.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

match.description: Explicit matching mode; default prefix. Fuzzy results carry suggestion evidence.

max_distance.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy matching.

max_elevation.description: Maximum stored elevation in meters. Unknown values do not match.

max_population.description: Maximum stored population. Unknown values do not match; the count may be undated.

min_elevation.description: Minimum stored elevation in meters. Unknown values do not match.

min_population.description: Minimum stored population. Unknown values do not match; the count may be undated.

order.description: Sort direction; default asc except population defaults to desc. Stable ids break ties.

page.description: Opt into next_cursor on search or named-nearby collections. A cursor also enables paging.

romanized.description: Include a reviewed official romanized name and its language. No ASCII-folding fallback; missing or conflicting forms are null.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort terms. Prefix a term with + or - for its direction. Stable ids break ties; unknown values sort last.

timezone.description: Exact IANA timezone filter, e.g. Europe/Vienna.

timezones.description: Include exact IANA timezones, as CSV or an array. Intersects with a single timezone filter.

type.description: Stored place type, such as city or ward; filters eligible places without inferring legal status.

name: city_search
title: City Search
